---
title: "tweedie_fit"
output: html_document

```{r}
library(mcglm)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
source("data_pipeline.R")

# Configuration
LEAGUE  <- "EPL"
SEASONS <- 2014:2024
WINDOW  <- 5
CONTROL <- list(tuning = 0.5, max_iter = 100, correct = TRUE)

# 1. Data Prep
xg_matches <- bind_rows(lapply(SEASONS, function(s) fetch_and_cache_xg(LEAGUE, s))) |> arrange(season, date)
matches_with_form <- compute_rolling_form(xg_matches, window = WINDOW)
stacked_xg <- stack_xg_matches(matches_with_form, window = WINDOW)

stacked_xg$att_roll_c <- stacked_xg$att_roll_xg - mean(stacked_xg$att_roll_xg)
stacked_xg$def_roll_c <- stacked_xg$def_roll_xg_against - mean(stacked_xg$def_roll_xg_against)

# 2. Baseline Model Fitting
rhs_base <- c("home", "ATT", "DEF")
if (nlevels(stacked_xg$season_f) > 1L) rhs_base <- c("season_f", rhs_base)
form_base <- stats::reformulate(rhs_base, response = "xg")

Z0 <- mc_id(stacked_xg)
Z1 <- list(tcrossprod(Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + match_f, data = stacked_xg)))

fit_base <- mcglm(
  linear_pred = c(form_base), matrix_pred = list(c(Z0, Z1)),
  link = c("log"), variance = c("tweedie"), power_fixed = c(FALSE),
  data = stacked_xg, control_algorithm = CONTROL
)

# 3. Elasticity Check
# Load shot aggregates to test the frequency/severity split
shots <- readRDS(file.path("data", UNDERSTAT_SHOT_FILES[[LEAGUE]]))

# Fix the side column BEFORE filtering so row counts align
shots$side <- Reduce(dplyr::coalesce, unname(as.list(shots[intersect(c("h_a", "home_away"), names(shots))])))

shot_agg <- shots |>
  filter(as.numeric(season) %in% as.numeric(SEASONS), result != "OwnGoal", situation != "Penalty") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) |>
  group_by(match_id, side) |>
  summarise(
    date = first(date), 
    home_team = first(home_team), 
    away_team = first(away_team), 
    n_shots = n(), 
    xg_sum = sum(xG, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(xg_mean_shot = xg_sum / n_shots) |> 
  dplyr::select(-match_id)

dat <- stacked_xg |>
  mutate(
    mu = as.numeric(fitted(fit_base)), 
    side = ifelse(home == 1, "h", "a"), 
    home_team = ifelse(home == 1, att_name, def_name), 
    away_team = ifelse(home == 1, def_name, att_name), 
    date = as.Date(date)
  ) |>
  inner_join(shot_agg, by = c("date", "home_team", "away_team", "side")) |>
  filter(n_shots > 0, xg_mean_shot > 0, mu > 0) |> 
  mutate(log_mu = log(mu))

glm_n <- glm(n_shots ~ log_mu, family = quasipoisson(link = "log"), data = dat)
glm_q <- glm(xg_mean_shot ~ log_mu, family = Gamma(link = "log"), weights = n_shots, data = dat)

cat(sprintf("\nElasticity Check:\nSum of GLM elasticities: %.3f (theory: exactly 1)\n", 
            stats::coef(glm_n)[["log_mu"]] + stats::coef(glm_q)[["log_mu"]]))

# 4. Residual Momentum
stacked_xg$fitted_xg <- as.numeric(fitted(fit_base))
stacked_xg$resid_xg  <- stacked_xg$xg - stacked_xg$fitted_xg

att_mom <- stacked_xg |> arrange(att, date) |> group_by(att) |> mutate(att_resid_roll = lag(zoo::rollsumr(resid_xg, k = WINDOW, fill = NA))) |> ungroup() |> dplyr::select(match_id, home, att_resid_roll)
def_mom <- stacked_xg |> arrange(def, date) |> group_by(def) |> mutate(def_resid_roll = lag(zoo::rollsumr(resid_xg, k = WINDOW, fill = NA))) |> ungroup() |> dplyr::select(match_id, home, def_resid_roll)

stacked_final <- stacked_xg |> left_join(att_mom, by = c("match_id", "home")) |> left_join(def_mom, by = c("match_id", "home")) |> filter(complete.cases(att_resid_roll, def_resid_roll))
stacked_final$att_resid_roll_c <- stacked_final$att_resid_roll - mean(stacked_final$att_resid_roll)
stacked_final$def_resid_roll_c <- stacked_final$def_resid_roll - mean(stacked_final$def_resid_roll)

form_final <- stats::reformulate(c(rhs_base, "att_resid_roll_c", "def_resid_roll_c"), response = "xg")
Z0_f <- mc_id(stacked_final)
Z1_f <- list(tcrossprod(Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + match_f, data = stacked_final)))

fit_final <- mcglm(
  linear_pred = c(form_final), matrix_pred = list(c(Z0_f, Z1_f)),
  link = c("log"), variance = c("tweedie"), power_fixed = c(FALSE),
  data = stacked_final, control_algorithm = CONTROL
)

cat("glm_n Results")
summary(glm_n)
cat("glm_q Results")
summary(glm_q)
```

```{r}
# 5. Model Diagnostics & The Tweedie Contradiction

analyze_tweedie_fit <- function(fit, shots_data, dat_joined) {
  
  # a. Model Fit Quality
  ll <- mcglm::plogLik(fit, verbose = FALSE)
  pbic <- mcglm::pBIC(fit, verbose = FALSE)$pBIC
  
  tb <- coef(fit, std.error = TRUE)
  p_agg <- tb$Estimates[tb$Type == "power"][1]
  
  # b. Elasticity Test (Volume vs Quality)
  glm_n <- glm(n_shots ~ log_mu, family = quasipoisson(link = "log"), data = dat_joined)
  glm_q <- glm(xg_mean_shot ~ log_mu, family = Gamma(link = "log"), weights = n_shots, data = dat_joined)
  e_vol <- coef(glm_n)[["log_mu"]]
  e_sev <- coef(glm_q)[["log_mu"]]
  
  # c. Empirical Shape Test
  m <- mean(shots_data$xG, na.rm = TRUE)
  v <- var(shots_data$xG, na.rm = TRUE)
  alpha_emp <- m^2 / v
  p_emp <- (alpha_emp + 2) / (alpha_emp + 1)
  
  cat("\n================ MODEL FIT (TWEEDIE) ================\n")
  cat(sprintf("Pseudo-BIC:                   %.1f\n", pbic))
  cat(sprintf("Degrees of Freedom:           %.1f\n", ll$df))
  cat(sprintf("Aggregate Tweedie Index (p):  %.3f\n", p_agg))
  
  cat("\n================ ELASTICITY SPLIT ===============\n")
  cat(sprintf("Volume Elasticity (2-p):      %.3f\n", e_vol))
  cat(sprintf("Severity Elasticity (p-1):    %.3f\n", e_sev))
  cat(sprintf("Sum of Elasticities:          %.3f (Theory: 1.0)\n", e_vol + e_sev))
  cat(sprintf("Implied p from split:         %.3f\n", 2 - e_vol))
  
  cat("\n================ SHOT SHAPE FLAW ================\n")
  cat(sprintf("Mean Shot xG:                 %.3f\n", m))
  cat(sprintf("Variance of Shot xG:          %.3f\n", v))
  cat(sprintf("Empirical Gamma Shape:        %.3f\n", alpha_emp))
  cat(sprintf("Implied p from shape:         %.3f\n", p_emp))
}

analyze_tweedie_fit(fit_base, shots, dat)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Isolate the shooting team from the aggregated match data
team_tactics <- shot_agg |>
  mutate(shooting_team = ifelse(side == "h" | side == "home", home_team, away_team)) |>
  group_by(shooting_team) |>
  summarise(
    matches = n(),
    avg_volume = mean(n_shots),
    avg_quality = sum(xg_sum) / sum(n_shots),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Define the crosshairs (league averages)
league_vol <- mean(team_tactics$avg_volume)
league_qual <- mean(team_tactics$avg_quality)

# 3. Generate the plot
ggplot(team_tactics, aes(x = avg_volume, y = avg_quality)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = league_vol, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = league_qual, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray60") +
  geom_point(color = "#1E7A5A", size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = shooting_team), vjust = -0.8, size = 3.5, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Team Tactical Profiles: Volume vs. Quality",
    subtitle = "Dashed lines represent the league average",
    x = "Shot Volume (Average Shots per Match)",
    y = "Shot Severity (Average xG per Shot)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Filter raw shots exactly as done in the diagnostic script
shots_filtered <- shots |>
  filter(
    as.numeric(season) %in% as.numeric(SEASONS),
    result != "OwnGoal",
    situation != "Penalty"
  )

# 2. Calculate the empirical Gamma parameters
m <- mean(shots_filtered$xG, na.rm = TRUE)
v <- var(shots_filtered$xG, na.rm = TRUE)
shape_param <- m^2 / v
rate_param <- m / v

# 3. Generate the plot
ggplot(shots_filtered, aes(x = xG)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 60, fill = "#5A6B7B", color = "white") +
  stat_function(
    fun = dgamma,
    args = list(shape = shape_param, rate = rate_param),
    color = "#F2B705",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.4)) + # Zoom in to show the mismatch clearly
  labs(
    title = "The Gamma Failure: Empirical vs. Theoretical Shot Quality",
    subtitle = "Gray: Actual Shot xG Density | Yellow: Theoretical Gamma Fit",
    x = "Expected Goals (xG) per Shot",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```
